audit_findings.implication: 400-label baseline supports source-scoped retention; no product equivalence inferred.
291 name groups cannot be keys; this scope differs from 178 terminology-query groups.
451 external label targets need an explicit referenced-but-not-collected identity policy.
62 shared-code groups need product boundary criteria; not merge approvals.
Shared chemical properties are review evidence, not automatic identity keys.
Exact and normalized lookup stages both contain ambiguity.
791 edges lack target descriptions; preserve source edges without inventing target properties or identity.
1269 claim occurrences remain separate; structural validity is not clinical approval.
Repeated spans/text do not establish identical assertions.
55 upstream-reported missing references need unresolved citation identities; this is not a fresh citation count.
230 records across 24 repeated-text groups retain their native identities.
3595 thread-context associations must not become direct ingredient-use claims.
159 comments need separate absent-ID and known-but-uncollected-target handling.
